title: Dream Chaser's House | KEY.co
description_expanded: We were hesitant to book this home as there were very few reviews. Dream Chaser is amazing and perfect in every way. Our family has be vacationing on 30A since 2007 and this home is far and away the best we’ve ever stayed in. The pictures don’t do the home justice and the home is absolutely gorgeous! Our family of 5 had more than enough room and loved it being dog friendly. The kitchen is completely stocked with everything possibly needed. There were even amenities for the dogs(crates, bowls). The back yard was perfect for our dogs. We do went most of our time on the screened porches watching tv and enjoying the weather. Dream Chaser is literally stocked with everything you need for a perfect visit to the beach! We always rent a golf cart while at 30A but this home had a golf cart included with our rental!! It is a short ride to the public beach access that has parking for the cart as well as cars. The beach is so close(walking distance) and was not crowded at all for our trip.
